record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: burn modifier checked inside Status (triggerBurn / updateBurn / healBurn); no PassiveEffects entry
record.summary: Passive.WELL_BAKED has no entry in PassiveEffects (queue uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY); it is read in three places in status.ts. FIDOUGH (1 star) and DACHSBUN (2 stars) are GOURMET + FAIRY + FIELD, maxPP 80, range 1, skill GROWL; nothing reads stars. (1) Status.triggerBurn: if the burn is applied (no IMMUNITY_BURN, no Rune Protect, not WATER_BUBBLE) and the unit was not already burning (alreadyBurning is read before the call changes anything), the holder calls addDefense(20, self, 0, false): requested +20 Defense, no AP scaling. A repeat burn while already burning refreshes the duration only (if longer) and adds no further Defense. (2) Status.updateBurn: every 1000 ms burn tick the burn damage is set to 0 (after all weather, Assault Vest, SWIFT_SWIM / HYDRATION / WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER modifiers have run), so handleDamage is not called for the burn tick; the Cooking Pot Speed gain still runs because it sits outside that check. (3) Status.healBurn (reached when burnCooldown runs out in updateBurn, and after clearNegativeStatus sets burnCooldown to 0 on the next update): if the unit was burning, burn is cleared and the holder calls addDefense(-20, self, 0, false) to remove the Defense. Applied amounts: addDefense passes the value through applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff, which scales a positive change and also a negative change when the caster is on the same team (here the holder itself), so with Big Eater Belt +20 becomes +25 and the removal -20 becomes -25 (symmetric, rounded down at 0 digits); Twist Band does not act (the removal is a same-team negative change); def is clamped at min 0. Defense is not permanent (the board reference is unchanged). The passive does not remove burn's other effects: handleHeal still halves healing on a burning unit (pokemon-state.ts:343) and a HISUIAN_TYPHLOSION attacker still deals x1.2 to a burning target, because status.burn stays true. If a burn is set by direct assignment instead of triggerBurn (the clone-from-reference copy, pokemon-entity.ts:1560), no +20 is granted but healBurn would still subtract 20 later; whether that path can reach a WELL_BAKED holder was not traced. The English text 'The Pokémon doesn't suffer from BURN damage. Instead, it gains 20 DEF when burning' matches this reading. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: Status.triggerBurn on the holder, when the burn is accepted and status.burn was false beforehand
Status.updateBurn burn tick (every 1000 ms while burning)
Status.healBurn when the burn ends (burnCooldown elapsed or burn cleared)

effects.kind: stat buff (Defense, self) on becoming burnt
effects.declaredRaw: pkm.addDefense(20, pkm, 0, false) when WELL_BAKED and !alreadyBurning
effects.scaling: none (apBoost 0, no crit); no star scaling
effects.resolution: Requested +20 Defense. Applied: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down (25); Twist Band not involved for a positive value; def = max(0, def + value); not permanent. Only on the transition from not burning to burning; a burn blocked by IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect or WATER_BUBBLE grants nothing.

The computed tick amount (5 % of maxHP times the weather / item / ability modifiers) is replaced by 0 before rounding, so the `burnDamage > 0` branch that calls handleDamage (TRUE damage, shouldTargetGainMana true) is skipped: no burn damage and no PP from burn ticks. The cooldown is still reset to 1000 and the Cooking Pot Speed +10 per tick still happens.

effects.kind: stat removal (Defense) when the burn ends
effects.declaredRaw: pkm.addDefense(-20, pkm, 0, false) in healBurn when WELL_BAKED
effects.resolution: Requested -20 Defense. Applied: Big Eater Belt applies to a negative change from a same-team caster, so -20 becomes -25 with the belt, matching the +25 given earlier; def clamped at min 0 so a unit whose Defense was lowered meanwhile can lose less than 20 relative to its current value. healBurn returns early if status.burn is false.

conditions: +20 Defense only when burning starts (status.burn was false); refreshing an existing burn does not stack
Burn must be accepted: IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect (runeProtect) and WATER_BUBBLE block it, so no Defense
Burn tick damage is removed, but heal reduction (x0.5 while burning), Hisuian Typhlotion x1.2 and other burn readers still treat the unit as burning
Magmarizer also zeroes burn damage and gives Speed on its own; the two effects are independent
record.resetBehaviour: Defense bonus is removed by healBurn when the burn expires or is cleared (clearNegativeStatus zeroes burnCooldown, so the next updateBurn calls healBurn); the buff is per fight and not permanent.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Whether the clone-from-reference copy can set burn without the Defense bonus on a WELL_BAKED holder (then healBurn would subtract 20 later) was not traced
roundToNDigits rounding of -25 under Big Eater Belt is exact (-20 x 1.25 = -25), so the rounding direction does not matter here
The many triggerBurn callers were not read; they share the guard
